The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, scattered spots that appear yellowish-tan with darker brown/reddish borders. Some tissue has fallen out creating holes, giving a ragged appearance. This is a **leaf** disease, narrowing to 16 candidates.

Top candidates based on symptoms: Bacterial_Blight (angular spots, yellow halos, ragged appearance), Bacterial_Pustule (small raised spots), Septoria_brown_spot (dark brown lesions), Frogeye_leaf_spot, Soybean_rust, Downy_mildew, Cercospora, Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with my top candidate.
Bacterial_Blight reference shows fewer, larger spots with prominent yellow halos. The test image has many more, smaller, denser spots. Not a strong match. Let me check Bacterial_Pustule.
That's a magnified view, hard to compare. Let me check Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria shows dark brown spots on yellowing lower leaves. The test image has a green leaf with lighter-colored spots. Let me check Frogeye leaf spot.
Frogeye leaf spot shows fewer, more distinct spots with gray centers and dark borders. The test image has far more numerous, smaller spots. Let me check Soybean_rust.

Soybean rust shows numerous small tan-brown spots densely scattered across the leaf. This is quite similar to the test image in spot density and distribution. Strong candidate. Let me check Downy_mildew.
Downy mildew shows diffuse yellow-green spots without the dark brown borders seen in the test image. Not a match. Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
SVN virus shows larger irregular spots along veins, very different pattern. Not a match. Let me check another Bacterial_Pustule reference at normal magnification.

This Bacterial_Pustule reference (Dise_100) is a strong match. It shows the same pattern of numerous small brown spots with yellowish-green halos scattered across a green leaf, very similar to the test image.

**Analysis summary across 8 reference views:**

| Class | Match Quality | Key Differences |
|-------|-------------|-----------------|
| Bacterial_Pustule | **Strong** | Same spot size, density, yellowish halos, brown centers |
| Soybean_rust | Moderate | Similar density but spots more uniformly reddish-brown, less halo |
| Bacterial_Blight | Weak | Fewer, larger spots with more prominent angular shape |
| Frogeye_leaf_spot | Weak | Fewer spots, gray centers with dark borders |
| Septoria_brown_spot | Weak | Dark brown on yellowing leaves, lower canopy |
| Downy_mildew | No match | Diffuse yellow-green, no brown borders |
| SVN virus | No match | Large irregular spots along veins |

The test image shows numerous small spots with light green/yellowish halos and brown centers on an otherwise green leaf. Some spots have coalesced into larger brown areas, and tissue has fallen out in places. This pattern matches Bacterial_Pustule: "Small light green spots with raised centers... developing light-colored pustules... lesions can grow together into large irregular brown areas."
